bugs_found.title: pandas dtype=str treated as numeric (all-zero cats)
bugs_found.detail: Gender/OverTime/JobRole etc. became median-imputed zeros because _is_categorical did not recognize dtype 'str'. Fixed via _is_stringy_dtype.

bugs_found.title: EmployeeNumber not auto-excluded as ID
bugs_found.detail: Pattern only matched employee_id, not employee_number. Fixed.

bugs_found.title: Dropped constants still required at predict
bugs_found.detail: EmployeeCount/StandardHours/Over18 remained in feature_columns after train drop. Now synced out of project.feature_columns post-fit.

bugs_found.title: Recommendation catalog is Telco/retail flavored
bugs_found.detail: HR high-risk case recommended discount_20, add_tech_support, autopay_incentive — not attrition-relevant. Same gap as Superstore.

bugs_found.title: Router reports cat=0% post-transform
bugs_found.detail: Categorical fraction measured on encoded matrix (codes are numeric). Misleading for diagnostics; not a scoring bug.
